direct_deps.distribution_note: The coordinator_core engine publishes from claude-klabauter to the public repo claude-klabauter, which is live — upstream_url resolves and a consumer installs the engine from it directly. Because the engine is a separate install, coordinator-claude's bin/ entrypoints resolve it at runtime through the env/registry rungs of cc_invoke rather than from anything inside this mirror; a check that strips those rungs is asserting a standalone-runnable contract this distribution does not make.

required_mcp_surfaces.description: Claude Code plugin context7@claude-plugins-official, enabled fleet-wide via settings.json enabledPlugins. Serves the MCP server plugin:context7:context7 (tools mcp__plugin_context7_context7__resolve-library-id / __query-docs) for live library/API documentation lookups.
required_mcp_surfaces.why: Required by docs-checker (its entire job is verifying API claims via Context7 — inert without it), enricher, executor, review-integrator, staff-eng, eng-director, staff-ux, staff-data-sci, and senior-front-end, which name these tools in their frontmatter and are degraded to guessing without them.

install.remediation: enable the context7 plugin: run /plugin in Claude Code and install/enable context7@claude-plugins-official from the claude-plugins-official marketplace (or add "context7@claude-plugins-official" to enabledPlugins in settings.json).

required_mcp_surfaces.description: External MCP server notebooklm-mcp, served by the PyPI package notebooklm-mcp-cli (CLI: nlm), registered as a Claude Code MCP server exposing tools under the mcp__notebooklm-mcp__ prefix.
required_mcp_surfaces.why: Powers deep-research Pipeline D; pipelines A/B/C are unaffected without it.

install.remediation: install: uv tool install notebooklm-mcp-cli (requires uv/uvx), then nlm login, then nlm setup add claude-code to register the notebooklm-mcp MCP server.

install.remediation: install git: winget install Git.Git (Windows) / brew install git (macOS)

probe.windows: if (Get-Command claude -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { exit 0 } elseif (Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.local\bin\claude.cmd") { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

install.remediation: install the Claude Code CLI — coordinator's canonical, preferred runtime (preferred over the desktop app): npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code. To START a coordinator session: open a terminal, run `cd ~/.claude`, then run `claude` — that launches Claude Code with your coordinator root (~/.claude) as the working directory. Whenever an install step says "restart your session from ~/.claude", that is the action: a terminal, `cd ~/.claude`, `claude`.

probe.windows: if (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { exit 0 } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { exit 0 } elseif (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

install.remediation: Disable WindowsApps python/python3 App Execution aliases (Settings > Apps > App execution aliases) then install Python 3.11+ from https://www.python.org/downloads/

probe.windows: bash -c '(( BASH_VERSINFO[0] > 4 || (BASH_VERSINFO[0] == 4 && BASH_VERSINFO[1] >= 3) ))'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

install.remediation: install bash >= 4.3 (macOS ships 3.2): brew install bash (macOS) — most Linux/WSL/Git-Bash is already 4.3+; ensure the modern bash precedes /bin/bash in PATH. coordinator-safe-commit uses local -n namerefs (bash 4.3+) and runs on every commit; scripts also use declare -A / mapfile.
install GitHub CLI: winget install GitHub.cli (Windows) / brew install gh (macOS)

install.posix: command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1 && brew install node || { echo 'Homebrew not found — install Node.js LTS via your platform package manager (apt/dnf) or nvm: https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm' >&2; exit 1; }
install.remediation: install Node.js LTS: brew install node (macOS) / apt|dnf install nodejs or nvm (Linux/WSL) / winget install -e --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS (Windows)

probe.windows: if (Get-Command gh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { exit 0 } elseif (Get-Command glab -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

install.remediation: configure git-host auth — recommended: gh auth login (GitHub) or glab auth login (GitLab); or add an SSH key / Git Credential Manager for your host
install uv: py -m pip install uv (Windows) / brew install uv (macOS) / pipx install uv (pipx)
install PowerShell 7: winget install Microsoft.PowerShell (Windows) / brew install powershell (macOS)
enable Git LFS so LFS-backed repos clone real objects: brew install git-lfs (macOS) / winget install GitHub.GitLFS (Windows), then git lfs install
install Unreal Engine via Epic Games Launcher if a downstream game-dev workflow requires it (not required for the base coordinator plugin)
